header.description: Replay a fitted MoE-layer neuron mask (dbm_expert_neuron.json) on a held-out split without re-fitting: each gate's file_path loads its fitted theta, the stages come back in eval mode, and both swaps run through the same hard theta>0 masks the fit was scored on. routed_gate declares group: expert_neuron as the fit did - the bundle's stamped group and group_map (num_experts, d_expert) are checked against what this document's site derives, so a table fitted over another model's experts, or replayed through a per-coordinate gate, is refused by name [V15]; shared_gate is the plain per-coordinate gate, checked at its own width. The routing-mismatch rule applies unchanged (a base slot whose expert is inactive on the counterfactual side keeps its base value), and routing_mismatch.json is written beside the replay's tables. No train section: the number saved is a confirmation one by construction. No entry selector: dbm_expert_neuron.json fits one cell, so each bundle holds a single theta. The dtype is part of the fit's ArtifactIdentity; omit it and the document implies fp32 and is refused against a bf16 fit.
